verdict.rationale: Slate's docs show it is installed as a global npm CLI and run as a terminal TUI. Onboarding asks for your terminal background, you can run shell commands with `!`, it accepts CLI flags like `--dangerously-skip-permissions`, and `/bug-report` works from inside the TUI. Together these describe a coding agent that runs locally from the developer's terminal. Missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of the local terminal workflow (community items do not address it).

support.subject: As a developer, I can run a coding agent locally from my terminal

citations.quote: Onboarding asks for your terminal background, multiline input preference, and model source
The `/bug-report` command lets you submit a bug report directly from the TUI.
We support `--dangerously-skip-permissions` (alias: `--yolo`) to bypass permission prompts.
